name: global_bink_paused
retail_role: 0 after init/resume, 1 after PauseGlobalBinkMovie; ApplyGlobalBinkVolume is a no-op while nonzero

name: shared_bink_surface_ptr
retail_role: IDirectDrawSurface7* for the generic 640x480 offscreen Bink decode surface

name: shared_bink_surface_desc
retail_role: 124-byte DDSURFACEDESC2; size=0x7C flags=7 height=480 width=640 caps=0x40

name: global_bink_handle
retail_role: Shared/global HBINK opened by OpenGlobalBinkMovie and cleared by CloseGlobalBinkMovie

name: global_bink_diag_max
retail_role: Optional diagnostic high-water value read from HBINK+0x32C while diagnostics are enabled

name: global_bink_diag_count
retail_role: Optional diagnostic counter incremented when HBINK+0x2FC is nonzero

name: global_bink_diagnostics_enabled
retail_role: Nonzero enables the two diagnostic counters after each global movie frame

name: generic_bink_frame_advance_latch
retail_role: Generic DecodeAndBlit helper: when clear modes 0/2 blit the first decoded frame without NextFrame; set to 1 after a successful nonterminal update

name: global_bink_skip_input_enabled
retail_role: When exactly 1, UpdateGlobalBinkMovie closes on any of the three shared input pulses

name: retail_drive_index
retail_role: -1 disables CD-root fallback; otherwise fallback drive letter is 'a'+index

name: game_movie_volume
retail_role: ApplyGlobalBinkVolume input; <5 maps to 37, otherwise trunc(volume*31000*0.01) with minimum 37

name: input_processing_gate
retail_role: OpenGlobal/Pause disable shared DirectInput processing; CloseGlobal/Resume re-enable it

name: SkippableOneShot
retail_role: Generic helper returns complete at end-of-stream or any shared input pulse

name: Looping
retail_role: Generic helper ignores end/input completion and always performs BinkNextFrame/BinkWait

name: UnskippableOneShot
retail_role: Generic helper ignores input but returns complete at end-of-stream
